The human rights NGO interviewed victims and witnesses of military operations conducted between June 2023 and December 2025 in seven localities in the regions of Timbuktu, Segou and Mopti.

Mali.title: Amnesty Report Accuses Mali Army, Wagner Group of War Crimes

Burkina Faso.title: Pix of the Day, 30 September, 2026 - Across the world
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso has inaugurated its first gold refinery as its military-led government seeks to strengthen economic sovereignty after breaking ties with its traditional Western partners. “From now on, Burkina Faso’s gold must not only be mined in Burkina Faso; it must also be processed, controlled, valued and certified there,” President Ibrahim Traoré said on Monday at the inauguration of the refinery, named Raffinor-BF.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso opens first gold refinery in push for economic independence
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso opened its first gold refinery on Monday, pushing ahead with plans to better organise the commercialisation of the precious metal in one of the continent's top producers. The west African nation is the continent's third leading gold producer, churning out more than 94 tonnes of the precious metal last year, according to the World Gold Council. But authorities traditionally struggle to control the informal gold mining sector, which has been blighted by jihadist violence and smuggling.

Burkina Faso.title: A historic night
Burkina Faso.summary: The Night of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP) is held this Wednesday, September 30, 2026 from 6 p.m. at the Place de la Révolution in Ouagadougou. This high-profile activity has a double objective: to pay tribute to the Defence and Security Forces (FDS) and Volunteers for the Defence of the Fatherland (VDP) and to present the achievements made in four years in various fields (health, agriculture, sport, technology, mining, etc.).

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: Rififi at the top!
Burkina Faso.summary: Is the bubble bursting between the president of the Burkinabe transition and his best support Ibrahima Maiga? What is certain is that there is electricity in the air, and the coming days could still be indicative of this degradation in the relations between the great propagandist Ibrahima Maiga and the government of Ibrahim Traoré.

Niger.summary: By Clare Nnabuike, Minna MINNA — No fewer than 47 people, mostly women, have been abducted by suspected bandits while harvesting groundnuts on farms in Mariga Local Government Area of Niger State. The incident occurred on Saturday at Tungan Rimi in Ma’undu-Beri Ward of the council area. The victims were said to have been working on their farms when the armed men invaded the area and took them into the forest.

Niger.title: Security operatives move to rescue 47 abducted farmers in Niger
Niger.summary: A joint security team comprising personnel of the Nigerian military and the Nigeria Police Force has moved into a forest in Niger State to rescue farmers abducted by suspected bandits. The spokesman for the Niger State Police Command, Wasiu Abiodun, disclosed this on Wednesday in a WhatsApp message, saying the operatives were combing Mukura village, Kasuwan-Garba District, in Mariga Local Government Area.

Niger.title: Food handover: The FSSP offers 636 25 kg bags of rice to insecure IDPs living in the Niamey region
Niger.summary: The Governor of the Niamey region, Major General Assoumane Abdou Harouna, presided, yesterday Tuesday, September 29, 2026 at the Niamey OPVN, the official delivery of food to internally displaced persons victims of insecurity in the Niamey region. Composed of 636 bags of rice, this donation was offered by the Solidarity Fund for the Safeguarding of the Fatherland (FSSP), thanks to the contributions of the population On this occasion, the Governor expressed his gratitude to the FSSP for this gesture of solidarity.

Niger.title: Agadez: two (2) individuals arrested in possession of a large quantity of drugs
Niger.summary: Two (02) individuals were arrested by the regional branch of the Central Office for the Suppression of Illicit Drug Trafficking (OCRTIS) in Agadez on 22 September 2026, police sources say. They are all residents of Dagamanett, a famous district of Agadez. According to the regional branch of OCRTIS, the first to be apprehended is a 32-year-old apprentice driver .

Niger.title: 7 West Africa: Niger - Niamey - The attack that exposed the ESA flaw
Niger.summary: The attack on Base 101 in Niamey in August 2026 revealed the existential vulnerability of the AES. Analysis of a night that forces the Sahel to rethink its sovereignty. The attempted mutiny against Niamey Air Force Base 101 brought the AES face to face with an existential question: what would become of the Confederacy if one of its three states tipped over?

Niger.title: Niger's army seizes weapons after quelling mutiny
Niger.summary: Members of the National Council for the Safeguard of the Homeland (CNSP) gather at a rally in support of General Abdourahamane Tiani outside the former National Assembly in Niamey, Niger, on September 2, 2026. /CFP Niger's Defense and Security Forces seized a large cache of weapons and military equipment after quelling a mutiny at Base 101 in Niamey, local media reported Wednesday, September 2.

Niger.title: Niger: Thousand Protest In Support Of Junta Leader After Foiled Mutiny
Niger.summary: By Enyichukwu Enemanna Thousands demonstrated in Niger’s capital on Wednesday, backing the West African country’s junta chief, General Abdourahamane Tiani, following a thwarted army mutiny at the weekend, Nigerien journalists reported. The rally in the capital, Niamey comes days after loyal supporters of the military government brought under control attempted uprising with the help of Russian mercenaries, but not before the capital was rocked by intense fighting across several highly sensitive sites.

Niger.summary: The Ambassador of the People's Republic of China to Niger, HE Jiang Feng, offered, this Saturday, February 8, 2025, a reception, on the occasion of the accreditation of the very first defense attaché, at the Embassy, Colonel-Major Chen Xuming. The ceremony organized for this purpose took place in the presence of an audience of guests, including officers of the Nigerien FDS, as well as defense attachés of embassies in Niger .
